name: Koinoki Shizuku
source:
A pure, sheltered young lady raised in a bubble.

Saint Merhata Academy, Class 2F. The only daughter of the global Koinoki conglomerate, one of the world's wealthiest families.

An exceptionally privileged young lady, even among the elite schools. Possesses a sense of common sense far removed from the real world.

Has a gentle personality and an aura that calms those around her. Pure and completely ignorant of anything sexual.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
